newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian by-election set for Feb 1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian by-election set for Feb 1.

text.p: The speaker of the Australian House of Representatives, Bob Halverson, said on Thursday a by-election for the seat of Fraser will be held on February 1.

The by-election was prompted by the resignation of the Labor opposition member John Langmore who will take up a position with the United Nations. Langmore held the seat at the March 1996 federal election by a margin of more than seven percent.
The ruling Liberal party has not announced an intention to contest the safe Labor seat, which is in Canberra, hard hit by by public service cuts.
